title: メディア情報学統合演習
subtitle: Media Informatics Integrated Exercises
teachers: 授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: The goal of this course is to teach students the abilities needed to solve  problems in information society using Media Informatics knowledge and technology. Students are expected to develop the ability to create specialized and advanced systems or contents that consider environmental conservation based on human-centered designs.
advice: In this course, students are given opportunities to comprehensively use the basic knowledge of Media Informatics, including the programming and audiovisual design skills learned in specialized Department of Media Informatics courses, as a means of facilitating communication and knowledge. As part of efforts aimed at learning how to solve problems in the AI information society, students will study R&D methods at companies, after which they will be provided with opportunities to create systems or contents aimed at environmental conservation based on human-centered designs. It is thought that, by developing e-learning contents using Media Informatics, IT knowledge, instructional design theory, and Web programming skills, students will acquire practical skills that are useful in the AI information society.
requiredKnowledge: All knowledge and skills acquired in the first to third years of the Department of Media Informatics are required.

activityGoals.body: Be able to propose problem solving using Media Informatics knowledge and technology.
Be able to create human-centered designs that consider environmental conservation.
Be able to develop advanced systems and contents.
Be able to advance projects in a planned and documented manner.
Be able to use knowledge and skills practically.

              The goal of this course is to teach students the abilities needed to solve  problems in information society using Media Informatics knowledge and technology. Students are expected to develop the ability to create specialized and advanced systems or contents that consider environmental conservation based on human-centered designs.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course, students are given opportunities to comprehensively use the basic knowledge of Media Informatics, including the programming and audiovisual design skills learned in specialized Department of Media Informatics courses, as a means of facilitating communication and knowledge. As part of efforts aimed at learning how to solve problems in the AI information society, students will study R&D methods at companies, after which they will be provided with opportunities to create systems or contents aimed at environmental conservation based on human-centered designs. It is thought that, by developing e-learning contents using Media Informatics, IT knowledge, instructional design theory, and Web programming skills, students will acquire practical skills that are useful in the AI information society.
